buyers_guide.q: Will a smart lock fit my door?
buyers_guide.a: Most smart deadbolts fit a standard US door with a 2-1/8 in. bore hole and a 2-3/8 or 2-3/4 in. backset. Retrofit locks like Level Bolt replace only the inside parts and keep your existing key and hardware.

buyers_guide.q: What happens if the batteries die?
buyers_guide.a: Locks warn you in their app before the batteries run out. Most also have a backup key, an emergency power point, or both. Check the listing for which one yours has.

Look for encrypted radios (Z-Wave S2, Matter, Thread, or the maker's encrypted Bluetooth), auto-lock, and an activity log. ANSI/BHMA grade ratings describe physical strength; Grade 2 or better is typical for a front door.
